description: This file contains unit tests for the core DataElement and LinkedDataElement classes, as well as a DataElementParser, utilizing the Google Test framework. The tests verify functionalities such as copying data, CRC computation, search, set/get number, bit manipulation, expansion/shrinkage, and linked data handling.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data element with methods for copying, CRC calculation, searching, setting/getting numbers, bit operations, and validation.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Represents a linked data element that can contain other DataElements and manage buffer sharing/enclosure.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: Parser class for reading and interpreting DataElement contents, checking validity, and skipping bytes.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into the data element from an array or another DataElement.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns or sets the size of the DataElement buffer.

methods.name: CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a specified range.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the DataElement is valid.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a numeric value at a specified position using specified endianness.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a numeric value from the DataElement at a specified position.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number within the DataElement using big-endian encoding.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for a byte sequence within the DataElement.

methods.name: SetBitNumber
methods.description: Sets bits in the DataElement within a specified range.

methods.name: GetBitNumber
methods.description: Retrieves bits from a specified range.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a byte value at a specified offset.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns the DataElement buffer according to specified type.

methods.name: Expand
methods.description: Expands the size of the DataElement buffer.

methods.name: Shrink
methods.description: Reduces the size of the DataElement buffer.
